messages: lina: Dropped a new tiny mock for the Billing > Usage compact list. Key asks: make spend rows scannable, surface invoice CTA better, decide where scope switch (org vs project) lives. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-compact sam: TL;DR: global header toggle is simplest. Per-row pills let you compare but add noise. Maybe per-row shown only in 'compare' mode? jo: Per-row is fine if the pill is micro (10-12px height) at end of row. Full chips are too heavy in compact. Also token number contrast fails AA in current mock. devon: Engineering: per-row scopes increases aggregation calls. We can batch requests server-side but that's a backend task. For sparklines use a pooled canvas renderer instead of many SVGs on mobile. lina: To unblock launch: do global toggle + an "Advanced compare" client-only mode (shows per-row pills) so we don't block on backend. Jo, add both artboards. sam: Invoice CTA is too hidden. Proposal: ghost button showing month + amount like "Invoice Jul $1.6K" that becomes solid on hover. Easier to scan for finance users. jo: Accessibility: change "Total tokens" -> "Est. tokens (total)" and increase number weight. Add aria-label for exact number: 12.3k. devon: I'll spike the canvas sparklines + a batched endpoint after the review. Also recommend adding telemetry when per-row mode is enabled to measure extra requests. design-bot: Reminder: design review Friday 11:00am. Agenda: compact rollout, invoice affordance, token contrast. lina: Action items: Jo update mocks, Devon spike, Sam validate CTA copy on small widths, I'll add infra note. Back after updates. :+1:
